root_cause.text: In mthca_create_srq(), when the copy of the SRQ number to userspace fails, the function releases the SRQ via mthca_free_srq() but fails to unmap the user database via mthca_unmap_user_db(), resulting in a resource leak that a user can trigger.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds the missing mthca_unmap_user_db() call in the error path of mthca_create_srq() after the ib_copy_to_udata() failure (diff in drivers/infiniband/hw/mthca/mthca_provider.c). The commit message states: "Add missed mthca_unmap_user_db() for mthca_create_srq()" and "Fix a user triggerable leak on the system call failure path."

agent_logs.evidence_points: The patch adds the missing mthca_unmap_user_db() call in the error path of mthca_create_srq() after the ib_copy_to_udata() failure (diff in drivers/infiniband/hw/mthca/mthca_provider.c). The commit message states: "Add missed mthca_unmap_user_db() for mthca_create_srq()" and "Fix a user triggerable leak on the system call failure path."

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix a resource leak in mthca_create_srq by unmapping the user doorbell on failure to copy SRQ number to user space.
intent_record.what: Added call to mthca_unmap_user_db before returning -EFAULT when ib_copy_to_udata fails in mthca_create_srq.
intent_record.how: On failure to copy the SRQ number to user space, the function now also unmaps the user doorbell, preventing a resource leak of the doorbell mapping.

intent_record.intent_summary: Add missing call to mthca_free_srq in mthca_destroy_srq to prevent resource leak.
intent_record.what: Added a call to mthca_free_srq(to_mdev(srq->device), to_msrq(srq)) at the beginning of mthca_destroy_srq, before the existing udata check.
intent_record.how: Ensures that the SRQ resources are freed when destroying the SRQ, regardless of whether user data context is present, fixing a resource leak.

intent_record.intent_summary: Remove redundant or erroneous call to mthca_free_srq in mthca_destroy_srq to prevent double free or resource corruption.
intent_record.what: Removed the call to mthca_free_srq() in the mthca_destroy_srq() function.
intent_record.how: The SRQ resources are no longer freed within this function, preventing potential double free or resource corruption if the freeing is handled elsewhere.

grouping_result.intent: Fix a resource leak in mthca_create_srq by unmapping the user doorbell on failure to copy SRQ number to user space.
Add missing call to mthca_free_srq in mthca_destroy_srq to prevent resource leak.
Remove redundant or erroneous call to mthca_free_srq in mthca_destroy_srq to prevent double free or resource corruption.

relevance_review.reason: The group directly addresses the exact resource leak described in the vulnerability root cause: it adds the missing mthca_unmap_user_db() call when the copy to userspace fails.

The vulnerability root cause involves a missing mthca_unmap_user_db() call in mthca_create_srq(), while Group 1 adds a missing mthca_free_srq() call in the destroy path, which is a different function and a different resource leak.

The vulnerability is about a missing mthca_unmap_user_db() in mthca_create_srq, while the group's change removes a redundant mthca_free_srq call in mthca_destroy_srq. These are different code paths and unrelated issues.

candidates.rationale: This condition triggers the error path when the copy to userspace fails. The following block is responsible for handling the failure, but it omits the necessary call to mthca_unmap_user_db(), resulting in a resource leak.
This statement partially cleans up by freeing the SRQ, but it does not unmap the user doorbell allocated earlier. The missing unmap causes the resource leak.
This return statement exits the function after only partial cleanup. It is the final statement of the error path and directly leaves the user doorbell mapped, constituting the resource leak.

vuln_statements.explanation: This condition triggers the error path when copying the SRQ number to userspace fails. The subsequent block fails to call mthca_unmap_user_db(), causing a resource leak.
This statement frees the SRQ but does not unmap the user doorbell allocated earlier, leaving the user database mapped and causing a resource leak.
This return statement exits the function after only partial cleanup, without unmapping the user doorbell, thus constituting the resource leak.

    Convert SRQ allocation from drivers to be in the IB/core
    
    Signed-off-by: Leon Romanovsky <leonro@mellanox.com>

diff --git a/drivers/infiniband/hw/mthca/mthca_provider.c b/drivers/infiniband/hw/mthca/mthca_provider.c
index 6fc371a9e45f..4f40dfedf920 100644
bic_trace_step.reason: In the new mthca_create_srq function, when ib_copy_to_udata fails (line 'if (context && ib_copy_to_udata(udata, &srq->srqn, sizeof(__u32)))'), it calls mthca_free_srq but does not call mthca_unmap_user_db. commit ec34a922d243c3401a694450734e9effb2bafbfe
Author: Roland Dreier <roland@eddore.topspincom.com>
Date:   Fri Aug 19 10:59:31 2005 -0700

    Add mthca support for shared receive queues (SRQs),
    including userspace SRQs.

diff --git a/drivers/infiniband/hw/mthca/mthca_provider.c b/drivers/infiniband/hw/mthca/mthca_provider.c
index 08a7340e19ff..23ceb26af8fe 100644
--- a/drivers/infin
bic_trace_step.reason: In mthca_create_srq(), when ib_copy_to_udata fails (line 'if (context && ib_copy_to_udata(udata, &srq->srqn, sizeof (__u32)))'), the code calls mthca_free_srq(to_mdev(pd->device), srq) and sets err = -EFAULT, then goes to err_free which only kfree(srq). However, it does not call mthca_unmap_user_db() to unmap the user database that was mapped earlier (if pd->uobject was set). This causes a resource leak, exactly as described in the root cause.
